# Journal

## Day 1 — 0:05
Chose Bruegel's 1563 Tower of Babel: the richest option (architecture + construction + landscape).
Structure logic borrowed from the Colosseum: tapering cone of superposed arcade rings, plus the
signature outer spiral ramp. Crown stays unfinished -> justifies cranes, scaffolds, workers.
Genesis 11 materials: fired brick + bitumen, lime plaster on finished parts.

## 0:10 — pipeline
build.py clears the scene, builds terrain/city/construction/tower from src/parts, adds 4 cameras
+ sun, saves the .blend and exports a .glb. All repetition is linked-duplicate instancing.


## 1:10 — silhouette, light, construction (M1+M2)
- Tower: 7 arcade tiers on a tapering cone, pilasters, cornices, terrace ledges with parapet rings,
  spiral ramp (2.3 turns) with corbels, stepped plinth, 24 buttress fins, grand gate facing the approach.
- Construction: 3 treadwheel cranes (crown + terraces), scaffold rings and wall scaffolds at the two
  work faces, brick stacks, 150 instanced workers, jagged raw masonry crown.
- Light: warm sun front-lights the camera side (all 4 cameras on -Y/+X); cool fill from the harbour side.
- Materials: PIL-generated brick/plaster/wood/ground/roof/bitumen textures, UV-mapped so they
  survive glTF export for the web viewer. Bump adds mortar relief in Cycles.
- Learned: this model has no vision -> src/analyze.py ASCII luminance maps are my eyes.


## 4:10 — surroundings complete, freeze (M3+M4)
- City (sub-agent): 405 houses in districts with a wall ring, gates, church, market, canal with bridges.
- Harbour (sub-agent): quay, docks, 12 moored boats with sails, lighthouse, crates; shoreline at y>170.
- Nature: 90 instanced trees, 26 field patches; brickworks with 5 clamp kilns + smoke, brick pallet
  mountains, ox carts on the approach road to the gate.
- Sky: Hosek-Wilkie physical sky (Blender 5 dropped Nishita), turbidity 3.6 for haze; warm sun
  front-lights the camera side, cool fill bounces from the harbour.
- Scene at freeze: 2,378 objects, 340 unique meshes, ~128k faces, 150k verts. Full build: 4.9 s.
- Draft cost at this size: 0.8-2.2 s per camera; preview 3.4-11.9 s.
